units.source_text: 我又抱着这种近似妄想的恐惧，恍如警官来到由良旅馆时，我突然害怕发觉似的，心里在嘀咕：

en.t: Once again, I was gripped by this almost delusional fear, as if, when the police officer came to the Yura Inn, I had suddenly been terrified of being found out, and I muttered to myself:

units.source_text: 老师是不是看守了我的计划，给我钱让我错过断然行动的机会呢？

en.t: Was my teacher keeping watch over my plan, giving me money so that I would miss the chance to take decisive action?

units.source_text: 我觉得珍惜地掌握着这笔钱的期间，就鼓不起断然行动的勇气。

en.t: I felt that as long as I held on to this money so carefully, I would not be able to summon the courage for decisive action.

units.source_text: 我一定要早日设法找到花掉这笔钱的途径。

en.t: I had to find some way to spend this money as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 只要是贫苦人，就想不出钱的好用途来。

en.t: As long as one is poor, one cannot think of any good use for money.

units.source_text: 我一定要设法找到这样一种用途，即老师知道后火冒三丈，即刻把我从寺庙赶出去。

en.t: I had to find a use for it that, once my teacher found out, would make him fly into a rage and immediately drive me out of the temple.
